title: refactor: unified rollouts autorollback workflow engine and canary/shadow integrations
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation: the existing autorollback implementation mixed policy evaluation, probe orchestration, and rollout lifecycle state inside the controller. This made adding new rollout modes (weighted canary, probing shadow) error-prone and prevented us from safely instrumenting multi-metric quorum logic. This PR refactors the autorollback engine to a standalone policy evaluation service and unifies canary/A-B/shadow handling into a single lifecycle flow (config v2), while preserving backward compatibility for v1 rollouts.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced rollout policy engine (rollouts/engine) that evaluates composite metrics, quorum, and quarantine logic.
- Decoupled decision surface from controller: controller now submits rollout events and receives actions (continue/pause/rollback/quarantine).
- Unified traffic adapters so canary, A/B and shadow modes share the same probing, metric aggregation and rollback triggers.
- Added preflight and quarantine states to reduce false positives from transient spikes.
- New config v2 supports conditional weighted canaries and staged shadow probing (backwards compatible with v1).
- Added telemetry hooks and per-rollout tracing identifiers to improve observability and debugging.

Checklist: 
- [x] Unit tests for policy engine and controller adapters
- [x] End-to-end stability tests for canary + shadow probing
- [x] Migration job to convert v1 rollouts to v2 where applicable (opt-in)
- [x] Dashboard panels and alert updates for rollout metrics
- [x] Docs update: docs/rollouts/migration.md and API changelog

Testing:
- Added e2e tests that run staged shadow + canary scenarios with synthetic metrics. Tests simulate metric quorum failures and verify quarantine/rollback behavior. CI run passed after one flaky retry on the probing integration (flaky test fixed).

Backward compatibility and rollout plan:
- v1 rollouts continue to operate unchanged by default. The migration job can be run per-tenant to opt into v2. New rollouts default to v2.
- We will enable the new policy engine behind an internal feature flag for 1 week in staging with canary traffic to internal services before rolling to production.

Notes for reviewers:
- Key files to focus on: rollouts/engine/policy.py, rollouts/controller/adapter.go, rollouts/tests/test_autorollback_e2e.py, observability/metrics/rollout_metrics.go.
- This PR intentionally keeps controller surface area minimal; the heavy logic is inside the engine which is unit-tested.

Related: linear/ENG-4821 (autorollback refactor), ENG-4905 (staged shadow probing), SUP-1291 (customer spike incident that motivated quarantine state).

If merged we should: run migration job on non-critical accounts, monitor new rollout metrics for 48h, and watch the canary service latency and error-rate graphs closely.
